meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 你会看到 Claude 先复现 LazyCodex/Codex 的错误,定位原因并做最小修复。如果属于上游 Codex,它生成带验证记录的 GitHub 拉取请求;如果属于 LazyCodex,则生成内嵌补丁的问题单,绝不发拉取请求。它不会直接改动你当前的项目。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 LazyCodex/Codex 相关的错误、为错误开拉取请求,或调试并提交某个缺陷的修复时触发。例如说“帮我修这个 Codex 错误并开拉取请求”即可唤起。

say.text: LazyCodex 装完一直报错,帮我修好并提交修复。
这个错误在上游 Codex 也能复现,帮我开个修复拉取请求。
say.note: 属上游时,会从 fork 创建修复拉取请求。

say.text: 请调试这个 Codex CLI 报错,定位根因后按流程交付修复。
say.note: 先判断归属,再走问题单或拉取请求渠道。

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex/Codex bug, Claude reproduces it and delivers a minimal fix. Upstream Codex bugs become a fork PR; LazyCodex defects become a verified-fix issue with patch, no PR. Includes regression tests, logs, cleanup.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to fix a LazyCodex/Codex bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and submit a defect fix. A request like 'fix this Codex bug and open a PR' will trigger it.

say_en.text: LazyCodex keeps erroring after install; please fix and submit a fix.
say_en.note: LazyCodex-owned bugs get an issue with patch, not a PR.

say_en.text: This bug also reproduces on upstream Codex; please open a fix PR.
say_en.note: It forks openai/codex and creates the PR.

say_en.text: Please debug this Codex CLI failure and deliver the fix correctly.
say_en.note: It decides ownership, then uses an issue or PR.
